items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Willigan, I forgot to mention him

ctx.x: Well, there's about another minute here, I was going to ask if there's any of the other old-time drummers, anything you could add about, say, old man Cantrell, or anybody else?

Well, you see, all of them I know is like I told you, a fellow of you know, he always talk about Black Benny, I never know Benny's right name, but you know Happy. You know Happy, you know, Ernest Rapania, we call it Trap, Faisal, Willigan, I forgot to mention him, that's all, and Alfred William, you know all of them. Yes. Chani, I forgot who that's about him.
We interviewed him a few months ago.

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Yeah, I don't know Willigan's first name, but he was a crack drummer.

ctx.x: Yeah, I don't know Willigan's first name, but he was a crack drummer. I can tell you about him, yeah.

items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: And he started wanting to send me on different jobs. Yeah. He liked the way I played, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah. I used to do lots of releases. After Willigan, he was playing drum. Mm-hmm. And he started wanting to send me on different jobs. Yeah. He liked the way I played, yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Well, what kind of stuff did he play, James Willigan?
